lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: JAMAL GRAB MY HAND BEFORE YOU FALL INTO THAT VOID [beat] THE ENTIRE ATTIC IS TURNING INTO A DEATH TRAP RIGHT NOW!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: My heart is pounding against my ribs [beat] as I watch the floorboards crumble into a dusty pit that definitely wasn't there five minutes ago.

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: I'm trying nix [beat] but there’s something wrapped around my ankle pulling me down into the darkness underneath this cursed house!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Oh my god rafiq [beat] do you see what’s shining at the bottom of that hole while the dust starts to settle around jamal's legs?

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: I told you we should have never opened this [beat] your father’s old inheritance was buried here for a reason and we just woke it up!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: It’s not just money [beat] look at the way those gold coins are moving on their own like they have a mind of their own in the shadows!

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: You children were always too curious for your own good [beat] and now you’ve found the real reason why this wing was locked for forty years.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Dada stop being cryptic and help us pull uncle jamal up [beat] before he gets swallowed whole by whatever is living down there in the dark!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: It’s a safe [beat] a massive iron safe with the family crest on it but the lock has already been smashed open from the inside!

lines.speaker: milli
lines.text: I can see eyes [beat] there are glowing yellow eyes staring back at us from the corner of the safe and they look incredibly hungry!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Sometimes the family secrets aren't just stories [beat] they are living nightmares waiting for someone to drop a flashlight and say hello.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait a second [beat] that’s not a monster in the safe [beat] that’s a photo of phupu with a mask on holding a massive crowbar!

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: You were never supposed to find my secret workshop nix [beat] and now that you have [beat] I can’t let any of you leave this attic alive!
